segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func createDisplayLink() { let displaylink = CADisplayLink(target: self, selector: #selector(step)) displaylink.add(to: .current, forMode: .defaultRunLoopMode) } func step(displaylink: CADisplayLink) { print(displaylink.targetTimestamp) } ```

```objc - (void)createDisplayLink { CADisplayLink *displayLink = [CADisplayLink displayLinkWithTarget:self selector:@selector(step:)]; [displayLink addToRunLoop:[NSRunLoop currentRunLoop] forMode:NSRunLoopCommonModes]; } - (void)step:(CADisplayLink *)sender { NSLog(@"%f", sender.targetTimestamp); } ```
